text:
Alex: starting smoke validation for telemetry on eu-central-1-gpu cluster — logs/metrics/traces stack is up but Loki not showing logs for gpu-nodepool-2. Anyone seen this?
Marta: saw that earlier, helm release for obs-stack failed on PVC provisioning. `kubectl -n obs get pvc` shows Pending for loki. I think our terraform module didn't set storageClassName for the loki pvc.
Raj: could be networkpolicy too — are we running a default deny in the obs namespace? `kubectl -n obs get networkpolicy` to check. Prometheus might be blocked from scraping node-exporter.
Alex: confirmed default deny present. prom scrape failing to reach node-exporter on 10.4.2.x — connection refused. I'll try a narrow allow rule for monitoring LB.
Samir: quick patch applied to allow monitoring ingress so scrapes can land: `kubectl -n obs apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-monitoring-from-prom
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-exporter
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: prometheus
EOF`
Marta: also update helm values for loki: set `persistence.enabled: true` and `persistence.storageClassName: gp2-fast`. Our terraform template was missing `persistence` map. Pushing a tiny fix to infra-terraform repo now.
Alex: after the network patch + helm values, logs started flowing into Loki. Prometheus targets show node-exporter UP. Loki ingestion ~120 req/s (observed via tailing pods).
oncall-bot: Deploy succeeded: helm upgrade obs-stack v2.3.1 in obs namespace by samir at 2026-03-15T10:12:33Z :rocket:
Raj: for handoff, here's a short checklist we should capture in the runbook:
- PV/PVCs bound and not Pending
- Prometheus targets count matches expected node count
- Grafana dashboards imported and rendering
- Alerting rules loaded and firing tests run
- Traces: OTLP endpoint reachable from app pods
- Cost tags applied to cluster resources (billing group + environment)
Samir: sharing commands I ran for verification:
```
# verify pvs/pvcs
kubectl -n obs get pvc,pv

# check prom targets locally
kubectl -n obs port-forward svc/prometheus 9090:9090 &
curl -s http://localhost:9090/api/v1/targets | jq '.data.activeTargets | length'

# check loki pod logs for ingestion errors
kubectl -n obs logs deploy/loki | tail -n 50
```
Marta: dashboards for this region are in infra/observability/dashboards/eu-central-1.json in the infra repo. Import with Grafana UI or use `grafana-cli` if you want automation.
Alex: alert templates to add: GPU memory pressure, node disk pressure, prometheus_scrape_failure (per-node), loki_ingestion_lag, and a tracing exporter unreachable alert. I'll draft PrometheusRule and a few alerts and open a PR.
Raj: cost note — switching to gp2-fast for loki + prometheus volumes ups monthly infra cost for this region by ~2.5k USD. Add to rollout cost sheet before sign-off.
Alex: handing off to platform oncall for continued observation. @samir please confirm you added the runbook entry and the handoff link.
Samir: added runbook checklist + steps to /handbooks/telemetry/eu-central-1 and marked handoff complete :white_check_mark:. Also included the terraform diff and helm values snippet.
ops-runbook-bot: Handoff recorded by samir in /handbooks/telemetry/eu-central-1 at 2026-03-15T10:25:01Z
Alex: thanks everyone — I'll monitor alerts for the next 2 hours and then close the loop. If anything regresses ping here or page oncall.
